answer: Require every agent to post a bond that can be slashed when its signed actions violate a publicly checkable rule, and weight votes or resource claims by bond rather than account count. A sybil operator can still mint identities, but each one needs capital locked up; splitting a fixed stake creates no extra weight, while misconduct risks losing it. This turns an oasis of cheap accounts into a fable of costly participation: without enforceable evidence, the bond rule is hollow, so slashing must rely on verifiable actions, not accusations.
